name: Tree bark hide
label: Hides
lead: Half-tube hide with a dark tree bark texture, open at both ends with a side opening - a tunnel for snakes and forest lizards.

description.html: This hide looks like a piece of hollow tree bark split lengthwise. The outside has a dark, rough, furrowed bark texture, and the inside is a passage open at both ends. One side also has an oval side opening, like a hole in a trunk.

Most snakes and forest-floor lizards love a tunnel with three exits. They can crawl through it, rest inside or peek out through the side opening, and always have several ways out. Tree bark is a natural choice for tropical and forest setups, alongside moss, leaves and branches.

You can partly bury the tunnel in the substrate so it looks like a fallen log sticking out of the ground. For species that like tight spaces, place it so one end is against the glass or a rock, which makes the inside darker. In a humid terrarium, moss around the tunnel helps keep the inside slightly moist.
The rough texture holds substrate and dirt, so scrub the hide with a brush under warm water from time to time.
